name: instagram_publish_media
description: POSTS IN PUBLIC, NO UNDO: publish a container made by instagram_create_media. Returns { id } — the media id, which instagram_get_media turns into a permalink a human can open. The Instagram API has no delete endpoint: once this returns, the post cannot be taken back from here, `degen-portal undo` cannot take it back, and only a human deleting it in the Instagram app can. The container must be FINISHED — check instagram_media_status first for video, reels and stories, or this fails with the media not being ready. 100 published posts per 24 hours per account; a carousel counts as one. If this fails, read the error and stop: a timeout can mean the post landed, and calling again is how the same thing gets published twice with no way to remove either.

creation_id.description: The container id instagram_create_media returned. For a carousel, the id of the CAROUSEL parent, not a child.
